words.note: hardly 是 barely 最直接、最常見的近義詞之一，表示某事只達到非常低的程度，幾乎等於『沒有』。常見於 hardly hear / hardly see / hardly know / hardly any。
words.example: I could hardly hear her over the noise.
words.exampleZh: 在噪音中，我幾乎聽不到她說話。

exercises.original: I could barely hear the announcement because the speakers were so quiet.
exercises.zh: 因為揚聲器聲音太小，我幾乎聽不到廣播。
exercises.upgrade: hardly · 幾乎不；幾乎沒有

options.explanation: clearly = 清楚地。和 speakers were so quiet 所造成的聽不清相反。
hardly = 幾乎不。could hardly hear 是非常自然的固定搭配。
easily = 輕易地。相反。
fully = 完全地。不能表達『幾乎聽不到』。
often = 經常。是頻率，不是程度。
exactly = 精確地。無關。

exercises.original: There was barely any food left by the time we arrived.
exercises.zh: 我們到達時幾乎已沒有食物剩下。
exercises.upgrade: hardly any · 幾乎不；幾乎沒有

options.explanation: plenty of = 很多。和幾乎沒有相反。
some extra = 額外一些。表示仍有多餘，不合語境。
enough = 足夠。原句強調幾乎沒有。
almost all = 幾乎全部。方向相反。
hardly any = 幾乎沒有。barely any 的最自然改寫。
fresh = 新鮮的。描述品質，不是數量。

exercises.original: She had barely slept the night before the exam.
exercises.zh: 考試前一晚她幾乎沒有睡。
exercises.upgrade: hardly · 幾乎不；幾乎沒有

options.explanation: hardly = 幾乎沒有。had hardly slept 直接表示睡眠量極少。
deeply = 熟睡地。不是睡眠量。
peacefully = 安穩地。不是時長或程度。
early = 早。不是幾乎沒有睡。
regularly = 規律地。無關。
comfortably = 舒適地。無關。

words.meaning: 幾乎不；幾乎沒有（較正式）
words.note: scarcely 和 barely / hardly 很接近，但語氣稍正式或書面。常見於 scarcely visible / scarcely enough / scarcely had... when...。
words.example: The path was scarcely visible in the fog.
words.exampleZh: 小路在霧中幾乎看不見。

exercises.original: The writing was barely visible in the dim light.
exercises.zh: 在昏暗光線下，字跡幾乎看不見。
exercises.upgrade: scarcely · 幾乎不；幾乎沒有（較正式）

options.explanation: brightly = 明亮地。不是可見程度。
fully = 完全地。相反。
clearly = 清楚地。和 dim light 不符。
scarcely = 幾乎不。scarcely visible 是自然書面搭配。
roughly = 粗略地。不是可見程度。
partly = 部分地。可能仍看得到不少，不等於幾乎看不見。

exercises.original: We had barely enough time to catch the last bus.
exercises.zh: 我們只有勉強足夠的時間趕上尾班車。
exercises.upgrade: scarcely enough · 幾乎不；幾乎沒有（較正式）

options.explanation: more than = 多於。會表示時間較充裕。
plenty of = 很多。和勉強足夠相反。
scarcely enough = 幾乎不夠／勉強夠。和 barely enough 高度對應。
far too much = 太多。相反。
exactly = 正好。只表示精確，不包含『差點不夠』。
unlimited = 無限。完全不合。

exercises.original: He could barely believe that he had won the competition.
exercises.zh: 他幾乎不敢相信自己贏了比賽。
exercises.upgrade: scarcely · 幾乎不；幾乎沒有（較正式）

options.explanation: openly = 公開地。無關。
completely = 完全地。方向不同。
readily = 輕易地／欣然地。和難以相信相反。
frequently = 經常。是頻率。
deliberately = 故意地。無關。
scarcely = 幾乎不。could scarcely believe 是自然較書面表達。

words.meaning: 剛剛；勉強；差一點就沒有
words.note: 當 barely 表示某事剛好達標、剛好及時或差點失敗時，only just 是最自然的近義片語之一。常見於 only just passed / arrived in time / enough。
words.example: She only just passed the exam.

exercises.original: He barely passed the driving test, scoring exactly the minimum required.
exercises.zh: 他剛好達到最低要求，勉強通過駕駛考試。
exercises.upgrade: only just · 剛剛；勉強；差一點就沒有

options.explanation: easily = 輕易地。和 exactly the minimum required 不符。
clearly = 明顯地。無法表達窄幅通過。
comfortably = 輕鬆地。相反。
decisively = 明確地／大幅地。不是剛好通過。
only just = 勉強。剛好達到最低線，是最精準。
widely = 大幅地。相反。

exercises.original: We barely arrived in time before the doors were locked.
exercises.zh: 我們在門鎖上前剛好趕到。
exercises.upgrade: only just · 剛剛；勉強；差一點就沒有

options.explanation: well before = 早很多。和勉強趕上相反。
only just = 剛剛。arrived before doors locked 是典型 only just in time。
much later = 晚很多。那就會錯過。
comfortably = 輕鬆地。沒有時間壓力。
regularly = 規律地。無關。
eventually = 最終。沒有『差點遲到』的意味。

exercises.original: The battery barely lasted until we reached the hotel.
exercises.zh: 電池勉強撐到我們抵達酒店。
exercises.upgrade: only just · 剛剛；勉強；差一點就沒有

options.explanation: only just = 勉強。battery lasted right up to the needed point，最自然。
easily = 輕鬆地。相反。
fully = 完全地。不是持續到某時的窄幅狀態。
regularly = 規律地。無關。
usually = 通常。頻率，不是程度。
comfortably = 輕鬆有餘。相反。

words.note: 當 barely 指以非常小的差距成功、避免失敗或避開危險時，可用 narrowly。常見於 narrowly win / pass / escape / avoid / miss。
words.example: The team narrowly won the final.
words.exampleZh: 球隊以極小差距贏得決賽。

exercises.original: The proposal barely passed, receiving 51 votes to 49.
exercises.zh: 提案以五十一票對四十九票勉強通過。
exercises.upgrade: narrowly · 以極小差距；險些；勉強

options.explanation: easily = 輕易地。51 比 49 顯然不是輕鬆通過。
unanimously = 全票一致。和票數不符。
narrowly = 以極小差距。51–49 是典型窄幅通過。
comfortably = 以明顯優勢。相反。
formally = 正式地。不是差距大小。
quickly = 很快地。不是票數差距。

exercises.original: The cyclist barely avoided the fallen branch in the road.
exercises.zh: 單車手險些撞上路上的倒樹枝，勉強避開。
exercises.upgrade: narrowly · 以極小差距；險些；勉強

options.explanation: deliberately = 故意地。沒有表達險些撞上。
normally = 正常地。無關。
completely = 完全地。只表示結果，不表示差點失敗。
slowly = 慢慢地。無關。
openly = 公開地。無關。
narrowly = 險些／勉強。narrowly avoided 是固定搭配。

exercises.original: She barely escaped injury when the shelf collapsed beside her.
exercises.zh: 架子在她旁邊倒下時，她險些受傷，勉強逃過。
exercises.upgrade: narrowly · 以極小差距；險些；勉強

options.explanation: quietly = 安靜地。無關。
deliberately = 故意地。受傷與否不是故意控制的。
fully = 完全地。不能表達險些出事。
narrowly = 險些。narrowly escaped injury 是非常自然的固定搭配。
regularly = 經常。無關。
eventually = 最終。沒有『差一點』意味。

words.meaning: 以極小差距；以微弱優勢
words.note: 當 barely 出現在選舉、比賽、投票、考試等可量化結果中，by a narrow margin 是很自然的改寫，強調成功或失敗只差一點點。
words.example: The candidate won by a narrow margin.
words.exampleZh: 候選人以微弱優勢勝出。

exercises.original: The team barely won the match, 3–2.
exercises.zh: 球隊以三比二的微弱差距贏得比賽。
exercises.upgrade: by a narrow margin · 以極小差距；以微弱優勢

options.explanation: by a landslide = 壓倒性勝利。相反。
by a narrow margin = 以微弱差距。3–2 是典型窄幅勝利。
without opposition = 無對手。和實際比分不符。
comfortably = 輕鬆地。相反。
unanimously = 全票一致。用於投票，不適合比分。
easily = 輕易地。相反。

exercises.original: The candidate barely won the election with 50.4 percent of the vote.
exercises.zh: 候選人以百分之五十點四的得票率微弱勝出。
exercises.upgrade: by a narrow margin · 以極小差距；以微弱優勢

options.explanation: by a narrow margin = 以微弱差距。得票率略過半是典型。
comfortably = 輕鬆地。50.4% 不是明顯優勢。
unopposed = 無競爭對手。顯然有選舉競爭。
decisively = 決定性地／大幅。相反。
easily = 輕易地。相反。
unanimously = 全票一致。和 50.4% 完全不符。

exercises.original: He barely passed the course, finishing one point above the pass mark.
exercises.zh: 他只比合格線高一分，勉強通過課程。
exercises.upgrade: by a narrow margin · 以極小差距；以微弱優勢

options.explanation: far above the mark = 遠高於合格線。相反。
with distinction = 優異成績。相反。
comfortably = 輕鬆地。相反。
easily = 輕易地。相反。
by a narrow margin = 以極小差距。one point above the pass mark 是決定性線索。
perfectly = 完美地。完全不符。

words.meaning: 差一點點；僅以極小差距（口語）
words.note: by a hair 是口語化慣用語，表示只差極小距離或極小幅度便會失敗。可形容勝出、錯過、避開事故等。
words.example: She won the race by a hair.
words.exampleZh: 她只以極小差距贏得比賽。

exercises.original: He barely won the sprint, crossing the line just ahead of his rival.
exercises.zh: 他只比對手早一點衝線，以極小差距贏得短跑。
exercises.upgrade: by a hair · 差一點點；僅以極小差距（口語）

options.explanation: by a landslide = 壓倒性地。相反。
easily = 輕易地。相反。
comfortably = 輕鬆地。相反。
without effort = 毫不費力。無法表達差距。
unopposed = 無對手。和 rival 不符。
by a hair = 只差一點點。just ahead of his rival 是典型。

exercises.original: The falling sign barely missed the parked car.
exercises.zh: 掉下來的招牌只差一點便砸中停泊的汽車。
exercises.upgrade: by a hair · 差一點點；僅以極小差距（口語）

options.explanation: widely = 大幅地。和差點撞中相反。
deliberately = 故意地。掉落招牌沒有意圖。
by a hair = 差一點點。missed by a hair 是自然口語。
completely = 完全地。只說結果，不表達極小差距。
slowly = 緩慢地。不是距離。
openly = 公開地。無關。

exercises.original: She barely avoided hitting the cyclist when he turned suddenly.
exercises.zh: 單車手突然轉彎時，她只差一點就撞上他。
exercises.upgrade: by a hair · 差一點點；僅以極小差距（口語）

options.explanation: widely = 遠遠地。相反。
carefully = 小心地。題目重點不是她的駕駛方式。
comfortably = 輕鬆有餘地。相反。
by a hair = 差一點點。表示極小安全餘量。
deliberately = 故意地。無關。
normally = 正常地。無關。

words.meaning: 差一點點；僅以極小差距（口語）
words.note: by a whisker 和 by a hair 很接近，也是常見口語慣用語，表示僅以極小差距勝出、通過或避開某事。
words.example: The horse won by a whisker.
words.exampleZh: 那匹馬只以極小差距勝出。

exercises.original: The horse barely won the race, finishing only centimetres ahead.
exercises.zh: 那匹馬只領先幾厘米，險勝比賽。
exercises.upgrade: by a whisker · 差一點點；僅以極小差距（口語）

options.explanation: by a whisker = 僅以極小差距。競賽語境非常自然。
comfortably = 輕鬆地。和 only centimetres ahead 不符。
by a mile = 大幅領先。相反。
easily = 輕易地。相反。
unopposed = 無對手。和比賽不符。
decisively = 明顯地。相反。

exercises.original: He barely passed the interview stage and was ranked last among the successful candidates.
exercises.zh: 他在成功候選人中排名最後，只是勉強通過面試階段。
exercises.upgrade: by a whisker · 差一點點；僅以極小差距（口語）

options.explanation: decisively = 明顯地。相反。
with ease = 輕鬆地。相反。
comfortably = 輕鬆有餘。相反。
by a large margin = 大幅度。相反。
by a whisker = 勉強／差一點。ranked last among successful candidates 是典型窄幅通過。
well above the line = 遠高於門檻。相反。

exercises.original: The ball barely missed the goalpost.
exercises.zh: 球只差一點便撞中門柱。
exercises.upgrade: by a whisker · 差一點點；僅以極小差距（口語）

options.explanation: widely = 遠遠地。相反。
by a whisker = 差一點點。missed by a whisker 是自然口語。
completely = 完全地。沒有極小差距意味。
slowly = 緩慢地。不是距離。
deliberately = 故意地。球沒有意圖。
regularly = 經常。無關。

words.word: By The Skin Of One'S Teeth
words.meaning: 勉強；千鈞一髮地；僅僅成功（慣用語）
words.note: by the skin of one's teeth 是很生動的慣用語，表示在幾乎失敗的情況下勉強成功，常用於通過考試、趕上交通工具、逃過危險等。
words.example: I passed the exam by the skin of my teeth.
words.exampleZh: 我勉勉強強才通過考試。

exercises.original: She barely passed the final exam with exactly the minimum score.
exercises.zh: 她剛好拿到最低分，勉強通過期末考試。
exercises.upgrade: by the skin of her teeth · 勉強；千鈞一髮地；僅僅成功（慣用語）
exercises.answer: by the skin of her teeth

options.explanation: with distinction = 優異地。相反。
easily = 輕易地。相反。
comfortably = 輕鬆地。相反。

options.text: by the skin of her teeth
options.explanation: by the skin of her teeth = 勉強成功。exactly the minimum score 是典型。
far above the line = 遠高於合格線。相反。
perfectly = 完美地。完全不符。

exercises.original: We barely caught the train; the doors closed seconds after we got on.
exercises.zh: 我們勉強趕上火車，上車幾秒後車門就關了。
exercises.upgrade: by the skin of our teeth · 勉強；千鈞一髮地；僅僅成功（慣用語）
exercises.answer: by the skin of our teeth

options.explanation: well in advance = 提早很多。和 seconds after we got on 不符。
regularly = 經常。不是時間裕度。
comfortably = 輕鬆有餘。相反。
without hurry = 不用趕。相反。
early = 早到。相反。

options.text: by the skin of our teeth
options.explanation: by the skin of our teeth = 勉強趕上。車門幾秒後關是最典型線索。

exercises.original: The hikers barely reached shelter before the storm hit.
exercises.zh: 遠足者在暴風雨來襲前千鈞一髮地到達避難所。
exercises.upgrade: by the skin of their teeth · 勉強；千鈞一髮地；僅僅成功（慣用語）
exercises.answer: by the skin of their teeth

options.explanation: well before = 早很多。相反。
comfortably = 輕鬆地。相反。

options.text: by the skin of their teeth
options.explanation: by the skin of their teeth = 千鈞一髮地。storm hit immediately after success 的感覺非常強。
slowly = 慢慢地。無法表達險些來不及。
regularly = 經常。無關。
eventually = 最終。沒有勉強及時的意味。

words.meaning: 微弱地；隱約地（只限感知語境）
words.note: 當 barely 修飾 visible / audible / perceptible 等，表示某物只以非常微弱的程度被看見、聽見或感知時，可用 faintly。這是受限近義詞，不適用於 barey pass / barely enough 等。
words.example: Music was faintly audible through the wall.
words.exampleZh: 隔着牆隱約可以聽到音樂。

exercises.original: A light was barely visible through the thick fog.
exercises.zh: 厚霧中只能隱約看見一道光。
exercises.upgrade: faintly · 微弱地；隱約地（只限感知語境）

options.explanation: clearly = 清楚地。相反。
brightly = 明亮地。和 thick fog 下勉強可見不符。
fully = 完全地。相反。
sharply = 清晰銳利地。相反。
faintly = 隱約地。visible through thick fog 是典型弱感知語境。
strongly = 強烈地。不是可見程度的自然搭配。

exercises.original: Her voice was barely audible from the back of the hall.
exercises.zh: 從禮堂後方只能隱約聽到她的聲音。
exercises.upgrade: faintly · 微弱地；隱約地（只限感知語境）

options.explanation: faintly = 微弱地。faintly audible 是很自然的搭配。
clearly = 清楚地。和 barely audible 相反。
loudly = 大聲地。相反。
fully = 完全地。不是聲音強度。
strongly = 強烈地。通常不說 strongly audible。
easily = 輕易地。相反。

exercises.original: The old writing was barely perceptible beneath the newer ink.
exercises.zh: 舊字跡在新墨水下面只能隱約辨認。
exercises.upgrade: faintly · 微弱地；隱約地（只限感知語境）

options.explanation: clearly = 清楚地。相反。
faintly = 隱約地。perceptible at a very low degree 是最精準。
fully = 完全地。相反。
boldly = 醒目地。和舊字跡被覆蓋不符。
strongly = 強烈地。不是 perceptible 的自然搭配。
easily = 輕易地。相反。

falseSynonyms.zh: 幾乎不等於一般的 barely almost 表示『差一點就達到某事』，而 barely 常表示『剛好達到』或『幾乎沒有』。例如 almost passed = 沒通過；barely passed = 通過了，但只差一點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Almost often stops short of the result; barely often means the result was only just achieved.

falseSynonyms.zh: 差不多；幾乎不等於一般的 barely nearly 和 almost 類似，通常表示接近但未必達成；barely 常表示剛好達標或程度極低。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Nearly means close to a point; barely means only just at or above it, or almost not.

falseSynonyms.zh: 稍微地不等於一般的 barely slightly 只表示程度小，不一定接近『幾乎沒有』或『勉強達標』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Slightly means a small degree, not necessarily a near-failure threshold.

falseSynonyms.zh: 很少；罕有不等於一般的 barely rarely 表示低頻率；barely 一般表示低程度或勉強達成。雖然 barely ever 可表示『幾乎從不』，barely 本身不是 rarely 的一般同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Rarely is about frequency; barely is usually about degree or threshold.

falseSynonyms.zh: 僅僅；只是不等於一般的 barely merely 表示『只是』，常用來降低重要性；barely 表示幾乎沒有或勉強達到。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Merely limits importance or identity; barely limits degree or margin.

falseSynonyms.zh: 短暫地不等於一般的 barely briefly 表示時間短，和 barely 的低程度／窄幅達成不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Briefly concerns duration, not degree or margin.

falseSynonyms.zh: 剛剛；只是；正好不等於一般的 barely just 在某些結構如 just managed to 可接近 barely，但它有『剛才、只是、正好』等多種常見意思，不能一般性互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Just overlaps in some threshold expressions but has several other common meanings.

falseSynonyms.zh: 少量；稍微不等於一般的 barely little 可表示少量，但詞性與結構和 barely 不同，也不自然替代 barely pass / barely visible 等大多數用法。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Little expresses small quantity or degree, but does not generally substitute for barely.
